meta.title: Raise a purchase intake request (article flow) and submit it for approval
gaps: Open the Intake page and create an article intake request with Request Title, Material Creation condition, Category, Subcategory, Currency, custom fields, Product Name, Quantity, Unit of Measure, and Delivery Location.
Review and confirm the auto-assigned approval chain and submit the intake through the Intake workflow.
Approve the intake and verify that the system automatically generates a Purchase Request.

plan.title: Submit Article Intake Request for Approval

args.goal: open the Intake page, click Create Request, fill the article intake fields including Request Title, Material Creation, Category, Subcategory, Currency, custom fields, Product Name, Quantity, Unit of Measure, and Delivery Location, advance through Basic Details and Details Page to the Approval Workflow, review the auto-assigned approval chain, submit the intake, and stop on the screen showing the intake was submitted for approval

steps.note: The catalog has no Intake-specific navigation or form steps, so this executes the requestor flow in the current buyer session.

args.need: approve the submitted intake as the required approver and verify that the resulting Purchase Request exists

steps.note: Approval and the resulting Purchase Request are not actions or observations available in the catalog.
After the tester completes approval, check for a visible Purchase Request indication if the resulting screen exposes that label.
